adjudication: The same AI developer read all 45 primary workbook rows and all 141 selected original mapping records in full before manually specifying expected row sets and gene sets. Source link coordinates/roles were transcribed mechanically from those reviewed records and checked against the manual sets. All 11 context mapping records and two context workbook rows were also read. No builder output or navigator query results generated these expectations. The developer had read the implementation and old evaluation.
independent_clinical_truth: Unavailable for the full expanded association set. These are shared-source conformance expectations, not a circular clinical accuracy benchmark.

unsupported_promotion_definition.source_unsupported: Tool candidate gene/source/MIM links absent from the complete reviewed source records for its returned row.
unsupported_promotion_definition.clinical_unsupported: Any explicit assertion that database association or condition approval establishes causal validity, variant suitability or family eligibility. Absence of that assertion is not usability evidence.
unsupported_promotion_definition.qualifier_loss: Source POLYGENIC or RelatedGenes distinctions omitted from the returned per-gene evidence; report as loss of source meaning, not as proof of clinical falsehood.
